sentences.en: Our genetic material is being constantly invaded by small egocentric molecular parasites.
sentences.zh: 我们的遗传物质不断受到一些自私的小分子寄生虫的侵袭。

sentences.en: Attention, everyone! By definition, babies are parasites. That is all... thank you.
sentences.zh: 请注意！根据定义，婴儿就是寄生虫。以上就是全部内容……谢谢。

sentences.en: You're nothing more than a social parasite!
sentences.zh: 你不过是个社会寄生虫罢了！

senses.zh: 寄生植物（或动物），寄生虫；不劳而获者，依赖他人过活者

mnemonic: para（旁边）+site（坐）→坐在旁边的→寄生虫
